profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer @ Gusto | AI x Developer Productivity

positions.title: Staff Engineering Manager, Modularity & Developer Productivity
Staff Engineering Manager, Payments
positions.description:
Led and scaled a critical engineering team focused on payments, growing from 8 to 13 engineers during a high-pressure growth period.

 ‣ Stabilized critical payment infrastructure, significantly reducing system incidents and on-call burden.
 ‣ Clarified team objectives and expectations, alleviating toil and improving overall team morale and productivity.
 ‣ Collaborated cross-functionally with engineering teams, PMs, and designers to streamline delivery of key initiatives.
 ‣ Managed engineering aspects of audits and compliance reporting, ensuring robust, secure, and compliant payment systems.
 ‣ Defined strategic roadmaps and directly managed project execution amidst intense workload and resource constraints.

Impact: Significantly improved team stability, clarified strategic direction, and strengthened collaboration, ensuring reliable and compliant payment systems crucial to business operations.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Productivity
positions.description:
Focused on scaling and improving developer productivity for a 500-engineer organization.

 ‣ Reduced CI/CD times by 30% through optimized parallelization (Buildkite, GitHub Actions).
 ‣ Significantly reduced infrastructure costs via Sidekiq optimizations.
 ‣ Contributed to major Ruby/Rails upgrades, enhancing security and maintainability.
 ‣ Architected modularization strategies for better system clarity and scalability.
 ‣ Improved observability and on-call processes through dashboards, tooling, and automation.
 ‣ Enhanced Kafka infrastructure and tooling, boosting data reliability and service performance.

Tech Stack: Ruby, Rails, Sidekiq, Redis, Kafka, Buildkite, GitHub Actions, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
Collaborated with a small, agile team to rapidly build an MVP for a crowdfunding platform aimed at community-driven fundraising for products, causes, and creative projects.

 ‣ Architected the system and selected core technologies, establishing a solid technical foundation for rapid development and scalability.
 ‣ Developed an intuitive developer experience, streamlining onboarding and significantly reducing ramp-up time for new engineers.
 ‣ Implemented Stripe payment integration, enabling secure, seamless transactions within the MVP.
 ‣ Directed platform implementation, providing hands-on mentorship and technical leadership to engineers throughout the development process.
 ‣ Collaborated closely with experienced entrepreneurs, contributing strategic insights during early-stage product planning and execution.

Tech Stack: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Heroku, Git, API integrations (Stripe)

Impact: Played a key role in delivering foundational technology and payment infrastructure, setting the stage for efficient future development.

positions.title: Engineering Manager (Head of Engineering)
positions.description:
Joined as a founding engineer and rapidly transitioned to leading engineering efforts, growing and managing a small team of engineers. Built an innovative financial analytics platform tailored for SMBs, particularly in ecommerce, to aggregate critical business data.

 ‣ Architected and developed an MVP that unified sales, marketing, ERP, and accounting data into a streamlined interface, providing insightful metrics on cash flow, customer LTV, COGS, and marketing ROI.
 ‣ Applied machine learning, statistical analysis, and financial modeling to enhance predictive analytics, helping clients optimize financial decisions and marketing strategies.
 ‣ Led full-stack system design and implementation (TypeScript, Node.js, React, Heroku, Terraform, PostgreSQL), creating robust integrations with QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon, Google, and social media platforms.
 ‣ Managed engineering operations, including project scoping, agile methodologies, team mentorship, hiring processes, and cross-functional collaboration with product and design teams.
 ‣ Contributed to successful fundraising rounds (Seed and Series A from Newfund, Bonfire Ventures, Recursive Ventures) and participated in the UC Berkeley SkyDeck Accelerator.
 ‣ Played a key role in pivoting the business model to include lending, leveraging deep financial insights to offer low-risk growth loans to ecommerce clients.

Tech Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, React, PostgreSQL, Heroku, Terraform, ML, statistics, API integrations (QuickBooks, Shopify, Amazon, Google APIs)

Impact: Built and scaled a data-driven financial platform that successfully supported top-tier ecommerce businesses, leading to the company's acquisition by CircleUp.

positions.title: Cofounder & CTO
positions.description:
Cofounded a pioneering blockchain infrastructure company, raising Series A funding from Draper Associates, Boost VC, and Vegas Tech Fund. Led the engineering strategy, team growth, and global deployment operations.

 ‣ Designed and built a robust Linux-based OS for blockchain mining hardware, enabling remote management, self-healing capabilities, and real-time performance analytics in extremely remote locations.
 ‣ Secured multimillion-dollar contracts to deploy hundreds of blockchain mining ASICs and GPUs across international sites, managing end-to-end deployment logistics.
 ‣ Identified critical security vulnerabilities impacting millions of cryptocurrency miners globally; coordinated directly with hardware manufacturers to implement comprehensive fixes.
 ‣ Engineered streamlined deployment processes, enabling a single technician to unbox, inventory, and deploy over 100 servers per hour with minimal training.
 ‣ Built and led a collaborative engineering team of five, managing several contractors and fostering a culture emphasizing pragmatism, curiosity, and effective problem-solving.
 ‣ Represented the company through speaking engagements, significantly enhancing company visibility and generating high-value leads and recruitment opportunities.

Tech Stack: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, Terraform, Heroku, Circle CI, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, React, Rust, C/C++, Shell scripting, Make, Go, MQTT, AMD/NVIDIA GPUs, Buildkite, Yocto

Impact: Successfully scaled from garage startup to global blockchain infrastructure leader, significantly influencing industry best practices in mining security and deployment efficiency.

positions.title: Cofounder & CTO
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Cofounded a branded hotel booking platform enabling conference and convention organizers to offer attendees lodging without traditional reservation risks or upfront expenses.

 ‣ Developed and launched an intuitive booking platform integrated with major travel aggregators like Expedia, monetized via commission-based accommodations.
 ‣ Secured early investment from notable funds including Vegas Tech Fund and The Mill following success at a Startup Weekend hackathon.
 ‣ Provided a seamless, branded booking experience, significantly enhancing event credibility and attendee satisfaction, particularly beneficial for smaller events.
 ‣ Collaborated closely with event organizers to tailor the platform, facilitating widespread adoption across multiple conferences.
 ‣ Iteratively refined and scaled the technology stack to ensure reliability, speed, and scalability, directly contributing to user growth and retention.

Tech Stack: Ruby on Rails, Heroku, PostgreSQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, API Integrations (Expedia, Twilio), Git

Impact: Successfully bridged a critical market gap for event organizers, enabling small-to-medium-sized events to confidently offer attendee lodging without financial risk.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Full-Stack
positions.description:
Joined a dynamic startup connecting users with local events globally, enabling easy discovery and ticket purchases through an intuitive digital platform:

 ‣ Architected and built a powerful search engine and web crawler to index and aggregate events worldwide.
 ‣ Developed an ETL pipeline for data deduplication, cleansing, and matching events to major ticketing platforms like Ticketmaster, significantly driving revenue through affiliate commissions.
 ‣ Rapidly shipped a minimum viable product (MVP) within one month, iterating swiftly with continuous input from executive leadership (CEO, COO, CMO).
 ‣ Designed and developed web frontend and RESTful API services for iOS and Android apps, providing seamless cross-platform user experiences.
 ‣ Optimized systems to efficiently process hundreds of millions of events, managing up to 12 GB/day at speed on a lean Heroku stack.
 ‣ Collaborated closely with a team of three engineers and company leadership, fostering a culture of innovation and rapid iteration.

Tech Stack: Ruby on Rails, MongoDB, API Integrations (Ticketmaster, Eventful), Mongoid, Heroku, RSpec, Cucumber, Selenium, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, REST, Git

Impact: Built scalable technology that directly contributed to achieving revenue-positivity, ultimately facilitating the company’s successful acquisition.

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer, Full-Stack
positions.description:
Joined as a founding engineer after competing in a Startup Weekend hackathon, creating a mobile ordering platform that let customers order and pay for food and drinks via their phones—years ahead of the major food delivery boom.

 ‣ Architected and developed end-to-end solutions including iOS/Android APIs, payment processing, marketplace deposits, order logic, sales tax calculations, and customizable menus.
 ‣ Built from scratch a secure payment gateway integration (IP Commerce, Vantiv), handling tokenization and PCI compliance, and verified with automated test suites (RSpec).
 ‣ Designed and implemented robust integrations with popular POS systems to streamline merchant onboarding and operations.
 ‣ Rapidly prototyped and launched the initial MVP in a single weekend, securing early investment and bootstrapping growth.
 ‣ Conducted pilots with diverse clients—including food trucks, restaurants, and bars across Las Vegas—to validate and refine the platform.
 ‣ Collaborated closely with solutions engineers, merchants, and stakeholders from a scrappy startup condo office, turning passion and hustle into real-world results.

Tech Stack: Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, RSpec, Heroku, HTML/CSS, REST, Git

Impact: Played a pivotal role in bringing a visionary product to life quickly, setting the stage for future food-tech innovations.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Full-Stack
positions.locationName: Las Vegas, Nevada, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Took on one of my first real engineering roles and hit the ground running — designing systems, rewriting legacy UIs, and helping modernize a small dev team’s entire workflow:

 ‣ Built a full-featured credit card billing system from scratch, improving reliability and giving the team ownership over a critical piece of infrastructure.
 ‣ Refactored core components across client projects, creating a shared codebase that drastically sped up new builds and cut dev costs.
 ‣ Led development on a platform for law enforcement to support at-risk youth — enabling secure data-sharing across agencies to better serve vulnerable communities.
 ‣ Revamped the admin UI serving clients, improving design, usability, and maintainability in collaboration with in-house designers.
 ‣ Managed client relationships directly — gathering requirements, scoping features, and leading delivery across multiple concurrent projects.
 ‣ Supported and mentored an intern, while working cross-functionally with a 5-person dev team in an Agile/SCRUM environment.
 ‣ Introduced automation to deployment and DB migrations using Chef, Capistrano, and custom scripts — replacing manual, error-prone workflows.
 ‣ Pushed for Git adoption across the company, modernizing version control and boosting collaboration.

Tech Stack: PHP, Ruby on Rails, MySQL, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Chef, Capistrano, Linux, Git/SVN

Impact: Brought fresh energy and modern practices to the team, helped deliver better products faster, and left a lasting impact in just a few months.

volunteerExperiences.description: Guiding Berkeley's ambitious entrepreneurship students towards success in the earliest days of their startups from validating an idea to shipping a product, and everything in between.

‣ Recruited top engineering talent through relationships with organizers and attendees.
‣ Prepared and presented in-depth talks on a variety of topics including FactoryBot, JRuby, auth, continuous integration, development processes/methodologies, and startups.
‣ Mentored at Ruby Weekend, a coding boot camp organized by the LVRUG.
‣ Attended my first meetup as a 16-year-old.
